intro: CKB works across four core interventions in Kurnool and Nandyal districts. Each has a published report, opened directly on the page.

items.title: School & Education
items.sub: Badi Bata — "Back to School" and child rights
items.desc: Enrolment drives that bring out-of-school children back into classrooms, supported by child-rights awareness in villages and follow-up with families and teachers.

items.title: Community Welfare
items.sub: Tribal communities, Dalits and people with disabilities
items.desc: Support for the most marginalised households in the operational area, including access to entitlements, awareness and community organisation.

items.title: Health & Nutrition
items.sub: Mother and child health, immunisation, fluorosis care
items.desc: Nutrition and immunisation support for mothers and infants, safe-delivery awareness, and dental, eye and general health check-up camps.

items.title: Economic Empowerment
items.desc: Livelihood support for marginalised families — skills, collective formation and market linkage for smallholder farmers.
